fundamentals.name: Firefly Aerospace Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Firefly Aerospace Inc. operates as a space and defense technology company and provides mission solutions for national security, government, and commercial customers in United States. The company offers integrated launch and space services technology that is committed to enabling launch, transit, and operations in space. It also provides Launch solutions, such as Alpha, a responsive launch services; and Eclipse, a medium-lift launch vehicles. In addition, the company offers spacecraft solutions platforms, including Blue Ghost, a lunar delivery and operation service; and Elytra, which provides space maneuverability and servicing. Further, it provides software and sensor solutions; national security software and big data processing capabilities; and responsive space services, as well as Ocula, a lunar imaging service. Firefly Aerospace Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Leander, Texas.

negatives: Operating margin -115.9% and Profit margin -193.8% — significant operational losses.
Return on equity -62.1% and Return on assets -16.8% — poor profitability and asset utilization.
Forward P/E -31.78 and Price/Sales 36.77 — valuation is extremely high given losses.
Debt/Equity 4.80 — high leverage relative to equity.

news.paragraph: Firefly Aerospace (FLY) has seen volatile price action recently, reversing overnight losses and then experiencing a dip on Monday, despite a significant year-to-date surge. The company is expanding its physical footprint in Texas, and while its revenue growth is strong, its operating and profit margins remain deeply negative. The stock's performance appears to be influenced by broader space sector movements and speculation around potential IPOs of larger players.
